profile.summary: Mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in Node.js backend systems, particularly Express.js. Demonstrates strong skills in dependency management, security vulnerability handling, and testing tooling. Focuses on maintaining robust backend infrastructure through systematic dependency upgrades and security hardening. Evidence shows deep familiarity with Express.js middleware ecosystem, testing frameworks (Mocha, Supertest), and CI/CD integration practices. Contributions are primarily backend-focused with no visible frontend or architecture-level work.
